description: Replay a saved flow by anchors without a model in the loop, returning {status:'ok', steps, url, title, ms, tokens_avoided}. On drift (missing anchor or host change), returns status:'drift' with full observation to act with browser_agent_act and repair via browser_agent_flow_save with the same name. Requires vars {name: value} for {{placeholders}} (fails before execution if missing). dry_run previews steps without browser action. A navigation step that browser_agent_act would guard returns guard {rule, host, mode, step} (warn: the step still ran).
name: browser_agent_run
